questions.solution:

questions.question: If 4x⁴=5x²-1, x>(1)/(sqrt 2), then what is the vale of (2x² - x - 1)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4x⁴=5x²-1, x>(1)/(sqrt 2)

**Concept used:**

ax² + bx + c = 0

Where a, b, and care the real terms

**Calculation:**

4x⁴ - 5x² + 1 = 0

⇒ 4x4 - 4x2 - x² + 1 = 0

⇒ 4x²(x² - 1) – 1(x2 - 1) = 0

⇒ (x2 - 1)(4x2 – 1) = 0

⇒ (x2 - 1) = 0 (4x2 – 1) = 0

x - 1 = 0

2x – 1 = 0

⇒ x = 1 or 1/2

(2x2 - x - 1)

Put x = 1

2 × 1 - 1 - 1

⇒ 2 - 2 = 0

**∴ Required answer is 0**

questions.question: Points A and B are on a circle with center O. PAM and PBN are tangents to the circle at A and B respectively from a point P outside the circle. Point Q is on the major arc AB such that ∠QAM = 58° and ∠QBN = 50°, then find the measure (in degrees) of ∠APB.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠QAM = 58°

∠QBN = 50°

**Concept used:**

The angles of an alternate segment subtended by a tangent to a circle are equal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96d35ab96232e2e0178d1a0988052a7a515bd864d595ea90b4e2c096877cf758.png] 

∠APM = ∠PNM and ∠BPN = ∠PMN

Alternate line segment theorem

cyclic quadrilateral theorem = The sum of a pair of opposite angles is 180° (supplementary)

**Calculation:**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47e82173d61a833d56f69add8efdbb7172c5308f80ec04ff3d6f37913afa9a81.png] 

The angles of an alternate segment subtended by a tangent to a circle are equal.

∠QAM = ∠ABQ = 58°

∠QBN = ∠BAQ = 50°

So, ∠AQB = 72° 

∠BOA = 2∠AQB = 2 × 72° = 144° 

In quadrilateral PBOA,

∠APB + ∠BOA = 180° (because OB ⊥ PN & OA ⊥ PM)

⇒ ∠APB = 180 - 144

⇒ ∠APB = 36°

**∴ The measure of ∠APB is 36°**

questions.question: If 4sin²(2x - 10)° = 3, 0 ≤ (2x - 10) ≤ 90, then find the value of frac{sin⁴(x-5)circ+cos⁴(x-5)circ}{1-2sin²(3x-15)circcos²(3x-15)circ}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4sin2(2x - 10)° = 3

**Formula used:**

sin90° = 1, cos90° = 0

sin30° = 1over2, cos30° = sqrt3over2 

**Calculation:**

4sin2(2x - 10)° = 3

⇒ sin2(2x - 10)° = 3over4

⇒ sin(2x - 10)° = sqrt3over 2

⇒ sin(2x - 10)° = sin60°

⇒ (2x - 10) = 60

⇒ 2x = 70

⇒ x = 35° 

frac{sin⁴(x-5)circ+cos⁴(x-5)circ}{1-2sin²(3x-15)circcos²(3x-15)circ}

⇒ frac{sin⁴(35 - 5)circ+cos⁴(35 - 5)circ}{1-2sin²(105 - 15)circcos²(105 - 15)circ}

⇒ frac{sin⁴30circ+cos⁴30circ}{1-2sin²90circcos²90circ} = {({1over2})⁴ + ({sqrt3over2})⁴}over{1-2×1×0}

⇒ (1/16 + 9/16)/(1)

⇒ {1+9}over16 = 10over16 = 5over8

**∴ The required value is 5/8**

questions.question: Each one of five men independently can complete a work in 20 days. The work is started by one person. Next day one more person joins and every next day one more person joins. From the fifth day, five persons continued working as a team. In how many days, will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Each man takes 20 days to complete the work

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of each man be 1

So, total work is 20 unit

So, on 1st day total work = 1 unit

Next day = 1 + 1 = 2 units

So according to this after 5th day total work has completed by 5 men = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5

⇒ 15 unit

So, remaining = 20 - 15

⇒ 5 unit

It will be completed in 5/5 = 1 day

So total time taken by them to complete the work is = 5 + 1 = 6 days

**∴ In 6 days, the work will be completed.**

questions.question: What is the area of the square (in cm²) whose vertices lie on a circle of radius 5 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the circle = 5 cm

**Concept used:**

Diagonal of a square = √2a

Area of a square = a² 

a = side of the square

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c32c5797a3198dc61b7bce6c516d9bc7d3d744503b48080726930084e0f7f32.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd0d1bce887f1643eddc0e1e5070c29bfb7df1ebc7ec66e8144dab7afdc693ce.png] 

Radius, AO = 5 cm

Diagonal AC of Square= AO + OC = 10 cm

Diagonal of a square = √2a

⇒ 10 = √2 a

⇒ a = 10oversqrt2 

Area of a square = a2

⇒ (10oversqrt2)² = 100over2 = 50 cm

**∴ The area of the square is 50 cm2**

questions.question: A man can row a distance of 8 km downstream in a certain time and can row 6 km upstream in the same time. If he rows 24 km upstream and the same distance downstream in 1(3)/(4) hours, then the speed (in km/h) of the current is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 24km

Time taken = 7/4 hours

**Concept used:**

Speed = D/t

D= Distance

t = time

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of man and current be v and s respectively. 

According to the question,

{8over v + s} = {6over v - s}

⇒ 8v - 8s = 6v + 6s

⇒ 2v = 14s

⇒ v : s = 7 : 1

Let speed of man = 7x

Speed of current = x

So,

24/8x + 24/6x = 7/4

⇒ 3/x + 4/x = 7/4

⇒ 7/x = 7/4

⇒ x = 4

⇒ speed of the current = 4 km/h

**∴ The speed of the current is 4 km/h**

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of A and B is 7 : 8. After 6 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 8 : 9. If C's present age is 10 years more than the present age of A, then the present age (in years) of C is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of present ages of A and B = 7 : 8

C = A + 10 years

**Calculation:**

Let present ages of A and B be 7x, 8x

(7x + 6)/(8x + 6) = 8/9

⇒ 63x + 54 = 64x + 48

⇒ 64x – 63x = 54 – 48

⇒ x = 6

Present age of C = 7 × 6 + 10

⇒ 42 + 10

⇒ 52 years

**∴ The present age of C is 52 years.**

questions.question: The average score of 40 students in a class test is 45. Later on, it was found that at two places 25 was read as 35 and at one place 38 was read as 32. What is the actual average score of the class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Avearge = 45

No. of student = 40

**Concept used:**

Sum of variables/No. of variables = Average of variables

**Calculation:**

Total of wrong score = 45 × 40

⇒ 1800

New total = 1800 – 35 × 2 + 25 × 2 – 32 + 38

⇒ 1800 – 70 + 50 + 6

⇒ 1800 – 14

⇒ 1786

New average = 1786/40

⇒ 44.65

**∴ The actual average score of the class is 44.65**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Total change = – 35 × 2 + 25 × 2 – 32 + 38

⇒ – 70 + 50 + 6

⇒ – 14

Effect of change in average = – 14/40

⇒ – 0.35

So, new average = 45 – 0.35

⇒ 44.65

∴ The actual average score of the class is 44.65
